note: Set B captures more useful engineering content — bolt diameter and length broken out, hex head type, adjustable footing type, CLEARVUE railing type, and the 2"X8" joist/frame correctly bound to the RAILING ATTACHMENT (C1) detail — while Set A repeats the joist/frame, grade-level and nail-spacing facts several times and includes tautological 'component = its own name' claims. Set A also misbinds the 8'-0" dimension to a generic 'deck connection' when it is the TYP. DECK MODULE (A1) dimension, which B states correctly. Both sets attach the 1'-4 3/4" spacing to the wrong context (A vaguely as 'deck connection', B explicitly as 'Detail C1' although that dimension string sits in detail A1) and both omit the A5 deck-to-house build-up. B's few errors are milder than A's duplication and trivial claims, so B is the better set.
remarks: Both extractions ignore the A5 deck-to-house connection build-up shown in the right-hand section: 3" STEEL DECKING, W10 X 15, 4-1/2" STRUCTURAL INSULATED PANEL W/ VAPOR BARRIER, CONTINUOUS WATERPROOFING MEMBRANE, 3" WOOD LAG SCREW WITH WASHER, and the 3/8" x 4" HEX BOLT there; the 4'-0" module dimension is also missed by both. The dimension string 1'-4 3/4" / 1'-4" / 1'-3 1/4" belongs to detail A1 (TYP. DECK MODULE), not C1, so B's 'Detail C1' condition is a misattribution and A's 'center to center' condition is unverified. Set A shows a clear pattern of restating the same fact under two names (joist/frame dimension x3, grade level x2, nail spacing x2, railing post bracket x2) plus tautological component claims.
